title: Desktop test suite must not fight the dev app for port 3000
description: The port is hardcoded (server.js:29 `const port = 3000`), so `npm run test:desktop` cannot run while the dev app is open — and worse, it does not fail: main.js finds :3000 already answering, the window loads the RUNNING app, and the specs silently drive the dev session with its real engine root and real user data. That blocks day-to-day work (hit during MPI-446: the suite could only be verified after the user closed the app). Make the port a variable the E2E launch picks: server.js reads it, main.js's four hardcoded `127.0.0.1:3000` references and tests/desktop/shellWindow.js's URL match follow it, and tests/desktop/launch.js hands each run a free port. A port already in use must then be a hard error, never a silent attach.
acceptance: npm run test:desktop passes with the dev app running on :3000, and does not touch it
The suite never silently attaches to an already-running server — a busy port fails loudly
server.js, main.js, tests/desktop/shellWindow.js and tests/desktop/launch.js all read the same port value
CLAUDE.md and docs/testing.md drop the "port 3000 must be free first" warning once it is untrue
